title: Add a parameter to an exported function and update call sites (all-.cppm)
prompt: In this mcpp C++23 modules project, module partition `calc:geometry` (src/calc/geometry.cppm, re-exported by the primary interface src/calc/calc.cppm) exports `double length(const vec2& v)`. Add a second parameter `double scale` that multiplies the result, and update every call site (including src/main.cpp) so the project builds and its tests pass.
